title: IGG: A Benchmark for Interactive GUI Grounding under Visibility Constraints
why: GUI grounding benchmark where agents must scroll, hover, drag or wait to reveal hidden targets before clicking; evaluates the reveal-then-ground perception/action step.
mechanism: Evaluation: interactive grounding with visibility constraints (viewport, multi-state, temporal/manipulation) across 16 mock GUI apps, action space scroll/move/drag/wait/click, success = click target within 8 actions.
evaluation_signal: 601 tasks, 7 sub-types; human 94.6% vs GPT-5.5 79.4% vs best open VLM 31.6%; controlled interventions telling Qwen3-VL which interaction to perform (per README/project page).
evidence_locator: README abstract and benchmark tables; project page abstract
retrieval_notes: Read repo README and project page only. Accepted EMNLP 2026 per authors (Kim, Son, Oh; KAIST). Paper and arXiv link 'coming soon'; no arXiv ID yet. Repo created 2026-10-22T12:32Z. No code executed.
